/* THE MAGNET REGISTRY — the only node a new lead magnet touches.
 *
 * Adding a magnet is ONE entry here plus a capture form on the page. No new
 * webhook, no new Caddy route, no new Twenty enum value, no second workflow.
 * That is the whole reason this endpoint is generic: plan-lead and
 * zone-workouts are two near-identical copies of the same six nodes, and a
 * third copy was the alternative to this file.
 *
 * Repo mirror: automation/tool-lead-workflow.json. n8n is the live source;
 * edit here, then mirror the change into the repo copy in the same session.
 *
 * Execution mode is Run Once for Each Item, set explicitly. A webhook delivers
 * one item today; the standing rule exists because a node written single-item
 * style misbehaves silently the first time an execution carries two.
 */

const MAGNETS = {

    noteLabel: 'Guia "Como alimentar tus sesiones largas" (articulos de nutricion)',

        '', m.pdf[lang], '',
        'O que mais muda o resultado esta na secao 3. O intestino se treina, e o bloco de seis semanas que esta dentro e o que separa o atleta que tolera 90 g/h do que fica sem nada no quilometro 30.',
        '',

  raceexec: {

      pt: 'https://triaperformance.com/pt/all-access/',
    },
    price: { es: '39,99', en: '39.99', pt: '29,99' },

      pt: 'Decidir no quilometro 30',

    /* Returns an ARRAY, like fueling. The single .join('\n') on emailBody below

    body: {
      es: (m, lang) => [
        'Hola,', '',

En un analisis de mas de dos millones de maratones, el desplome de ritmo empieza en promedio a los 29,6 km — y le pasa al 28% de los hombres y al 17% de las mujeres. Nadie entrena esa parte. Un atleta que llega ahi con tres metas escritas no tiene una carrera arruinada: tiene una carrera distinta.',

/* The footer every send carries. unsubscribe-runbook.md §Footer copy: never
 * omit it to make a message feel more personal, and name the reason they are
 * hearing from you — that is the half that reduces complaints. The reason
 * differs from the CoachMatch footer because the reason really is different:
 * they asked for a guide on the website, not about coaching on TrainingPeaks. */
const FOOTER = {
  es: 'Recibes este correo porque pediste la guía en triaperformance.com.\nSi no quieres recibir más, date de baja aquí:',
  en: 'You are receiving this because you asked for the guide on triaperformance.com.\nIf you would rather not hear from me, unsubscribe here:',
  pt: 'Você recebe este email porque pediu o guia em triaperformance.com.\nSe preferir não receber mais, descadastre-se aqui:',
};

const LANG_ENUM = { es: 'SPANISH', en: 'ENGLISH', pt: 'PORTUGUESE' };

const body = $('Webhook - Tool Lead').item.json.body || {};
const email = String(body.email || '').trim().toLowerCase();
const magnetKey = String(body.magnet || '').trim();
const lang = (LANG_ENUM[body.language] ? body.language : 'es');

/* Fail loudly on a bad payload rather than minting a token and mailing nobody.
 * A magnet key that is not in the registry is the likely mistake: a page shipped
 * with a form before its entry was added here. */
if (!/^[^@\s]+@[^@\s]+\.[^@\s]+$/.test(email)) {
  throw new Error('tool-lead: invalid or missing email in payload');
}
const m = MAGNETS[magnetKey];
if (!m) {
  throw new Error('tool-lead: unknown magnet "' + magnetKey + '" — add it to the registry in this node');
}

return {
  json: {
    email: email,
    magnet: magnetKey,
    lang: lang,
    langEnum: LANG_ENUM[lang],
    subject: m.subject[lang] || m.subject.es,
    emailBody: (m.body[lang] || m.body.es)(m, lang).join('\n'),
    footerPrefix: FOOTER[lang] || FOOTER.es,
    pdf: m.pdf[lang] || m.pdf.es,
    leadNotes: m.noteLabel + '. Idioma: ' + lang + '. Pagina: ' + (body.page_url || 'n/a'),
    pageUrl: body.page_url || '',
  },
};

parameters.query:
-- 32 hex from gen_random_uuid(), which is a CSPRNG and needs no extension.
-- md5(random()) would also be 32 hex and would NOT be unguessable, which is
-- the property schema-email-suppression.sql relies on: a token cannot be
-- constructed for an address you do not already hold one for.
INSERT INTO unsubscribe_tokens (token, email, lang, source)
VALUES (replace(gen_random_uuid()::text, '-', ''), $1, $2, $3)
RETURNING token;
